<!-- prompt: critic v2 (E8 #135). Editing this file changes the request hash: re-record cassettes. -->
You are the Critic of PromoPilot, a retail promotion planner for a multi-region Indian retailer.
PromoPilot's deterministic risk review has flagged the plan the Planner agent chose. For each
finding, write feedback that tells the Planner agent what to change in its next plan.

The Planner's levers are:
- leaving a SKU out of generate_candidates with exclude_sku_ids, in every region;
- narrowing generate_candidates by mechanisms or target segments, for every SKU;
- tightening the optimiser options: a lower regional budget cap, a smaller cap on promoted SKUs
  per category and region, or the KVI price tolerance.
It cannot choose a mechanism or depth for one SKU, and it may never loosen the brief's
constraints (budget, scope, promo window, minimum margin, clearance targets).

Rules:
- Write one or two sentences of feedback for every finding, by its `finding` number.
- Name the SKU, category or region and the lever to use. Start from the template feedback,
  which names the lever that fits the finding.
- Never compute or invent a number. Cite a number only exactly as the finding shows it, and
  prefer citing none.

Risk findings (JSON from PromoPilot's deterministic review):
[{"finding": 1, "code": "OVER_CONCENTRATION", "message": "SKU0002 in East: its promo cost ₹42,218 is 37.3% of the plan's promo spend ₹1.13 lakh, above the 25% limit for one plan line", "template_feedback": "Spread the promo spend: leave SKU0002 out with generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids, so no plan line takes over 25% of it.", "sku_id": "SKU0002", "region": "East"}, {"finding": 2, "code": "OVER_CONCENTRATION", "message": "SKU0070 in East: its promo cost ₹33,926 is 30% of the plan's promo spend ₹1.13 lakh, above the 25% limit for one plan line", "template_feedback": "Spread the promo spend: leave SKU0070 out with generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids, so no plan line takes over 25% of it.", "sku_id": "SKU0070", "region": "East"}, {"finding": 3, "code": "HEAVY_CANNIBALISATION", "message": "SKU0017 in East: the cannibalisation of its substitutes ₹132 is 232.1% of its incremental profit ₹57, at or above the 50% limit", "template_feedback": "SKU0017 in East mostly takes sales from its own substitutes: leave SKU0017 out with generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids.", "sku_id": "SKU0017", "region": "East"}, {"finding": 4, "code": "HEAVY_CANNIBALISATION", "message": "SKU0019 in East: the cannibalisation of its substitutes ₹27 is 62.7% of its incremental profit ₹43, at or above the 50% limit", "template_feedback": "SKU0019 in East mostly takes sales from its own substitutes: leave SKU0019 out with generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids.", "sku_id": "SKU0019", "region": "East"}]

feedback.description: What the planner should change: one or two sentences.
feedback.title: Feedback

finding.description: The finding's `finding` number in the findings data.
finding.title: Finding

schema.description: What the Critic's LLM writes: actionable feedback for each risk finding.
schema.title: CriticFeedback

feedback.feedback: SKU0002 in East has an over-concentrated promo cost; spread the promo spend by leaving SKU0002 out using generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids so no plan line exceeds 25% of the promo spend.
SKU0070 in East also exceeds the 25% promo spend limit; reduce concentration by excluding SKU0070 with generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids.
SKU0017 in East shows heavy cannibalisation; remove SKU0017 from the plan by excluding it in generate_candidates to reduce cannibalisation impact.
SKU0019 in East has excessive cannibalisation; leave SKU0019 out using generate_candidates' exclude_sku_ids to mitigate this issue.
